subject: effect
style: Original cozy chunky pixel game icons with 1-pixel warm charcoal selective outlines, ivory bubble interior, hard square pixel clusters, only 3 shades per material. Each icon about 22x22 logical pixels. No antialiasing, gradients, noise or dithering. Character reference is STYLE ONLY; no people.

report_item.action: One little ivory paper report with folded top-right corner, 3 charcoal horizontal lines and tiny teal checkbox, about 14x18 logical pixels. No letters or words.

bubbles.action: SIX STATIC speech/status bubbles, same ivory rounded square silhouette and small attached tail, separate evenly spaced: frame 0 teal working GEAR; frame 1 three violet THINKING dots; frame 2 orange WAITING question mark ?; frame 3 teal DONE checkmark; frame 4 navy sleeping zzz letters; frame 5 orange SURPRISED exclamation mark !. Glyphs are intentionally required game symbols, and lie INSIDE each connected bubble. No character.

role_badges.action: TWO STATIC tiny wearable accessories isolated as connected sprites: frame 0 gold supervisor badge with simple small crown silhouette on navy square pin, about 7x7 logical pixels; frame 1 cream sub-agent ID card attached to dark navy neck lanyard loop, about 8x13 logical pixels. No human or clothes. These are game overlay objects.
